title: Read API and MCP tool for the ledger summary

story.i_want_to: ask loopctl the chg audit questions through an MCP tool
story.so_that: a session can answer them without a browser and without curl, which the fleet guard refuses

rationale: CLAUDE.md: an operator-facing endpoint is not done until an MCP tool calls it.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/v1/chg_ledger/summary (role :agent, tenant from the key) answers the same aggregates the dashboard shows, filtered by repo, host, since and until, computed by the same context functions the LiveView calls.

MCP tool chg_ledger_summary calls it; it is declared and dispatched in mcp-server/index.js, has a row in mcp-server/README.md, and its description names the filters and the key it needs. A wiring test pins declaration and dispatch.
The operation/2 spec documents the filters, the period cap (at most 90 days per call, one module attribute) and the answer shape.

test_cases.name: summary matches the dashboard source
expected_results: the counts equal the context function's

technical_notes: Follow an existing read tool's lib/ module shape in mcp-server.
Bump the mcp-server version so mcp-autopublish ships it.
